metadata.description: Prototype Claude Code mods that show the state of a Strikethroo workspace. Read-only; Strikethroo's own gates decide.

plugins.name: strikethroo-progress
plugins.description: Shows the active Strikethroo plan's phase and task progress above the prompt, in a pane, and through /strikethroo-status.

plugins.name: strikethroo-review-findings
plugins.description: A pane listing the findings in a plan's review/review.xml, with buttons to copy path:line or draft a prompt about a finding.

plugins.name: strikethroo-scope-watch
plugins.description: Warns when Claude edits a file outside the in-progress task's Output Artifacts. Warns only; never blocks.

plugins.name: strikethroo-claim-check
plugins.description: Adds one dim line when Claude's answer claims success and no test or build command ran this turn.
